description: The file defines a RecyclerView adapter class 'NotesAdapter' used for displaying a list of notes in an Android application. It manages view holders, diffing, and click handling for note items.

classes.name: NotesAdapter
classes.description: A RecyclerView adapter for displaying a list of Note objects, with diffing support and click handling.

methods.name: Diff
methods.description: An object that provides diffing callback implementations for Note objects.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates a new ViewHolder instance for a note item view.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds Note data to the corresponding ViewHolder.

classes.name: VH
classes.description: ViewHolder class holding references to the UI components of a note item view.

methods.name: Diff.areItemsTheSame
methods.description: Checks if two Note items are the same based on their IDs.

methods.name: Diff.areContentsTheSame
methods.description: Checks if the content of two Note items is the same.
